Package game

Class Game

java.lang.Object
game.Game
public class Game extends Object
The Game class represents the state and progression of a game session within a lobby. It tracks the game's status, associated lobby, number of players, the current round, and the number of rounds voted on. It also maintains the maximum number of rounds allowed in a game.
